title: Bootstrap Multi-Page Web Lab (Interactive Q&A)
description: Best for friends & family starting an empty repo. Attaches .agents, reads the architecture notes, asks a couple of quick questions about your idea, and scaffolds the full app.

title: Bootstrap Multi-Page Web Lab (Direct Template)
description: Skips the Q&A round and builds right away when you already know your project name and first tool.

title: Bootstrap Any Project (General Purpose + Interactive)
description: For Python tools, CLIs, libraries, or when you want the agent to recommend the right project type and stack first.

title: Add a New Page / Tool to an Existing Web Lab
description: Use inside a repo already bootstrapped with the Vite MPA + MDX + PWA setup to add another tool card and page.

title: Attach dot-agents Submodule Only
description: Drops .agents/ into any new or existing repo tracking main with update = rebase, without changing project code.

title: Update .agents Submodule to Latest main
description: Pulls new skills or bootstrap note updates into an existing project and commits the updated submodule pointer.
